Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.

We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.

Job Details

The Head of Infrastructure & Platforms is responsible for the operational leadership, delivery, and continuous improvement of the organization's global infrastructure and platform services.

The role manages multiple technical disciplines, including cloud infrastructure, enterprise networking, identity services, endpoint management, server and hosting platforms, and related infrastructure operations. The postholder ensures that these services are secure, reliable, supportable, and delivered in accordance with approved business, financial, security, and compliance requirements.

Working within the direction set by senior IT leadership, the role establishes departmental objectives, operating procedures, work plans, and priorities; manages the department budget; allocates resources; and delegates assignments across experienced technical professionals and, where applicable, subordinate managers.

The successful candidate will combine effective people leadership with broad technical knowledge and sound tactical decision-making. The role is expected to resolve complex operational issues, deliver larger infrastructure projects, and translate approved technology plans into practical, measurable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Departmental Leadership & Operational Planning

Establish departmental objectives, operating procedures, work plans, delivery priorities, and performance expectations in line with approved IT strategy and organizational policies.
Translate approved infrastructure roadmaps into operational plans, resource assignments, schedules, and measurable departmental outcomes.
Make implementation decisions within delegated authority and escalate matters that require broader functional or enterprise direction.
Provide recommendations to senior IT leadership regarding infrastructure architecture, operational risk, service improvement, and technology investment.

Infrastructure & Platform Service Delivery

Manage the reliable and secure delivery of enterprise networking, cloud infrastructure, data center and hosting services, identity platforms, endpoint management, collaboration infrastructure, and server services.
Coordinate the work of multiple infrastructure disciplines and ensure clear ownership, effective handoffs, and consistent operating practices.
Monitor service availability, capacity, performance, supportability, technical debt, and lifecycle risk, implementing corrective plans where required.
Establish and review departmental KPIs, SLAs, operational health measures, and service improvement actions.

Cloud & Platform Implementation

Manage delivery of cloud infrastructure services across Azure, AWS, and related hosting environments in accordance with approved architecture and governance standards.
Plan and deliver approved cloud migrations, platform upgrades, infrastructure rationalization, and legacy hosting reduction activities.
Ensure cloud and hosting environments meet defined requirements for resilience, security, cost, supportability, documentation, and operational readiness.
Work with application owners, architects, Security, and service providers to sequence and deliver migration and modernization plans.

Network Architecture & Engineering Oversight

Manage enterprise network services and provide technical direction across SD-WAN, routing and switching, firewalls, network segmentation, VLAN and VRF design, internet and WAN connectivity, and hybrid cloud networking.
Oversee network workstreams for site openings, relocations, consolidations, lab environments, and business segmentation initiatives.
Review technical designs and implementation plans to confirm alignment with approved standards, security controls, operational support requirements, and change processes.
Advise technical teams on moderately complex network and infrastructure matters and coordinate resolution of issues that span disciplines.

Endpoint, Identity & Security Platforms

Manage infrastructure delivery and operational support for endpoint management, device compliance, identity services, privileged access controls, endpoint security platforms, and infrastructure hardening standards.
Deliver approved transitions and improvements involving Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure Arc, and related endpoint and identity services.
Coordinate implementation with Information Security, Service Desk, regional IT, and technical suppliers.
Ensure controls and operational procedures are applied consistently, documented, monitored, and remediated where gaps are identified.

Compliance, Resilience & Risk

Implement infrastructure controls and remediation plans required to support CMMC, NIST-based controls, ISO standards, government or defense requirements, and internal audit activities.
Manage departmental activities relating to network segmentation, access governance, asset and configuration records, infrastructure baselines, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Maintain evidence and documentation required to demonstrate that assigned infrastructure controls are operating as intended.
Identify departmental risks, assess operational impact, define corrective actions, and report significant risks to senior IT leadership.

IT Service Management & Change Governance

Ensure infrastructure teams comply with established Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, Configuration, Request, and Access Management processes.
Represent Infrastructure in CAB, problem review, major incident, service review, and operational governance forums.
Oversee pilot planning, implementation sequencing, risk and impact assessment, business and Service Desk communications, rollback planning, and post-implementation review for major infrastructure changes.
Improve departmental procedures and supporting ServiceNow workflows within delegated process ownership and governance.

Budget, Suppliers & Cost Management

Prepare, manage, and monitor the departmental infrastructure budget in accordance with approved financial plans and delegated authority.
Manage day-to-day relationships and performance across managed service providers, cloud providers, network carriers, hosting providers, security vendors, and technology partners.
Support sourcing, contract renewal, service review, and purchasing decisions by providing technical requirements, usage data, risk assessments, and recommendations.
Identify and implement approved opportunities to consolidate services, reduce unnecessary cost, improve licensing efficiency, and optimize infrastructure consumption.

People Leadership & Global Ways of Working

Manage and develop experienced infrastructure professionals across multiple disciplines and regions and, where applicable, oversee subordinate managers or team leads.
Delegate assignments, establish accountability, review delivery, coach team members, and address capability or performance gaps through established management processes.
Build effective operational collaboration across regional and offshore teams, supporting consistent standards and follow-the-sun delivery.
Maintain departmental succession plans, skills development priorities, architecture documentation, standards, runbooks, diagrams, and knowledge-sharing practices.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Work regularly with senior management, Security, Architecture, application teams, business stakeholders, suppliers, and customers on infrastructure matters affecting several operational areas.
Present analysis, delivery options, risks, cost implications, and recommendations to support departmental decisions.
Influence stakeholders in sensitive or complex situations while preserving productive working relationships and maintaining focus on approved outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
A minimum of 12 years of relevant infrastructure experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 8 years with a Master's degree, or equivalent experience.
Significant experience managing a department or multiple infrastructure disciplines, including experienced technical professionals and/or subordinate managers.
Demonstrated experience delivering complex infrastructure projects and operational improvements within approved strategy, budget, and governance.
Broad technical knowledge across enterprise networking, cloud platforms, identity services, endpoint management, infrastructure security, server platforms, and IT operations.
Experience managing departmental budgets, suppliers, contracts, service performance, and cost optimization activities.
Working knowledge of ITSM processes and platforms, including Change, Incident, Problem, Asset, Configuration, Request, and Access Management.
Strong written, verbal, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and recommendations to senior management.
Ability to obtain and maintain security clearance if required.

The description provided above is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all job duties, responsibilities and requirements. Duties, responsibilities and requirements may change over time and according to business need.

$165,000.00 - $190,000.00* + benefits.

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The base pay for this position ranges from our lowest geographic market up to our highest geographic market.

added.title: Head of Infrastructure (Remote)
added.description:
Business Unit

Cubic Corporation

Company Details

When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.

We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.

Job Details

The Head of Infrastructure & Platforms is responsible for the operational leadership, delivery, and continuous improvement of the organization's global infrastructure and platform services.

The role manages multiple technical disciplines, including cloud infrastructure, enterprise networking, identity services, endpoint management, server and hosting platforms, and related infrastructure operations. The postholder ensures that these services are secure, reliable, supportable, and delivered in accordance with approved business, financial, security, and compliance requirements.

Working within the direction set by senior IT leadership, the role establishes departmental objectives, operating procedures, work plans, and priorities; manages the department budget; allocates resources; and delegates assignments across experienced technical professionals and, where applicable, subordinate managers.

The successful candidate will combine effective people leadership with broad technical knowledge and sound tactical decision-making. The role is expected to resolve complex operational issues, deliver larger infrastructure projects, and translate approved technology plans into practical, measurable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Departmental Leadership & Operational Planning

Establish departmental objectives, operating procedures, work plans, delivery priorities, and performance expectations in line with approved IT strategy and organizational policies.
Translate approved infrastructure roadmaps into operational plans, resource assignments, schedules, and measurable departmental outcomes.
Make implementation decisions within delegated authority and escalate matters that require broader functional or enterprise direction.
Provide recommendations to senior IT leadership regarding infrastructure architecture, operational risk, service improvement, and technology investment.

Infrastructure & Platform Service Delivery

Manage the reliable and secure delivery of enterprise networking, cloud infrastructure, data center and hosting services, identity platforms, endpoint management, collaboration infrastructure, and server services.
Coordinate the work of multiple infrastructure disciplines and ensure clear ownership, effective handoffs, and consistent operating practices.
Monitor service availability, capacity, performance, supportability, technical debt, and lifecycle risk, implementing corrective plans where required.
Establish and review departmental KPIs, SLAs, operational health measures, and service improvement actions.

Cloud & Platform Implementation

Manage delivery of cloud infrastructure services across Azure, AWS, and related hosting environments in accordance with approved architecture and governance standards.
Plan and deliver approved cloud migrations, platform upgrades, infrastructure rationalization, and legacy hosting reduction activities.
Ensure cloud and hosting environments meet defined requirements for resilience, security, cost, supportability, documentation, and operational readiness.
Work with application owners, architects, Security, and service providers to sequence and deliver migration and modernization plans.

Network Architecture & Engineering Oversight

Manage enterprise network services and provide technical direction across SD-WAN, routing and switching, firewalls, network segmentation, VLAN and VRF design, internet and WAN connectivity, and hybrid cloud networking.
Oversee network workstreams for site openings, relocations, consolidations, lab environments, and business segmentation initiatives.
Review technical designs and implementation plans to confirm alignment with approved standards, security controls, operational support requirements, and change processes.
Advise technical teams on moderately complex network and infrastructure matters and coordinate resolution of issues that span disciplines.

Endpoint, Identity & Security Platforms

Manage infrastructure delivery and operational support for endpoint management, device compliance, identity services, privileged access controls, endpoint security platforms, and infrastructure hardening standards.
Deliver approved transitions and improvements involving Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure Arc, and related endpoint and identity services.
Coordinate implementation with Information Security, Service Desk, regional IT, and technical suppliers.
Ensure controls and operational procedures are applied consistently, documented, monitored, and remediated where gaps are identified.

Compliance, Resilience & Risk

Implement infrastructure controls and remediation plans required to support CMMC, NIST-based controls, ISO standards, government or defense requirements, and internal audit activities.
Manage departmental activities relating to network segmentation, access governance, asset and configuration records, infrastructure baselines, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Maintain evidence and documentation required to demonstrate that assigned infrastructure controls are operating as intended.
Identify departmental risks, assess operational impact, define corrective actions, and report significant risks to senior IT leadership.

IT Service Management & Change Governance

Ensure infrastructure teams comply with established Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, Configuration, Request, and Access Management processes.
Represent Infrastructure in CAB, problem review, major incident, service review, and operational governance forums.
Oversee pilot planning, implementation sequencing, risk and impact assessment, business and Service Desk communications, rollback planning, and post-implementation review for major infrastructure changes.
Improve departmental procedures and supporting ServiceNow workflows within delegated process ownership and governance.

Budget, Suppliers & Cost Management

Prepare, manage, and monitor the departmental infrastructure budget in accordance with approved financial plans and delegated authority.
Manage day-to-day relationships and performance across managed service providers, cloud providers, network carriers, hosting providers, security vendors, and technology partners.
Support sourcing, contract renewal, service review, and purchasing decisions by providing technical requirements, usage data, risk assessments, and recommendations.
Identify and implement approved opportunities to consolidate services, reduce unnecessary cost, improve licensing efficiency, and optimize infrastructure consumption.

People Leadership & Global Ways of Working

Manage and develop experienced infrastructure professionals across multiple disciplines and regions and, where applicable, oversee subordinate managers or team leads.
Delegate assignments, establish accountability, review delivery, coach team members, and address capability or performance gaps through established management processes.
Build effective operational collaboration across regional and offshore teams, supporting consistent standards and follow-the-sun delivery.
Maintain departmental succession plans, skills development priorities, architecture documentation, standards, runbooks, diagrams, and knowledge-sharing practices.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Work regularly with senior management, Security, Architecture, application teams, business stakeholders, suppliers, and customers on infrastructure matters affecting several operational areas.
Present analysis, delivery options, risks, cost implications, and recommendations to support departmental decisions.
Influence stakeholders in sensitive or complex situations while preserving productive working relationships and maintaining focus on approved outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
A minimum of 12 years of relevant infrastructure experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 8 years with a Master's degree, or equivalent experience.
Significant experience managing a department or multiple infrastructure disciplines, including experienced technical professionals and/or subordinate managers.
Demonstrated experience delivering complex infrastructure projects and operational improvements within approved strategy, budget, and governance.
Broad technical knowledge across enterprise networking, cloud platforms, identity services, endpoint management, infrastructure security, server platforms, and IT operations.
Experience managing departmental budgets, suppliers, contracts, service performance, and cost optimization activities.
Working knowledge of ITSM processes and platforms, including Change, Incident, Problem, Asset, Configuration, Request, and Access Management.
Strong written, verbal, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and recommendations to senior management.
Ability to obtain and maintain security clearance if required.

The description provided above is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all job duties, responsibilities and requirements. Duties, responsibilities and requirements may change over time and according to business need.

$165,000.00 - $190,000.00* + benefits.

added.title: Sr. Manager, AP Technology
added.description:
Be part of an amazing story.

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work. 

Job Overview

The Senior Manager, Asset Protection Technology is responsible for leading the deployment, adoption, execution, and ongoing optimization of Asset Protection technology solutions across stores, supply chain operations, and field organizations. Guided by service and anticipation, this role partners with Asset Protection leadership, Macy's Technology, Operations, Supply Chain, Fraud, vendors, and field teams to evaluate business needs and deliver technology solutions that enhance operational effectiveness, risk mitigation, and shortage reduction.

The Senior Manager, AP Technology oversees implementation and support strategies for video management systems, RFID solutions, investigative technologies, exception reporting platforms, and other Asset Protection tools. This role leads proof-of-concept testing, business case development, technology rollout planning, training initiatives, and change management efforts to ensure successful adoption across the organization. The Senior Manager also manages vendor partnerships, expense budgets, project execution, technology governance, and a team of AP Technology Managers supporting regional operations.

Success in this role requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, business partnership, and project management capabilities, along with the ability to translate operational challenges into scalable technology solutions that support Macy's Asset Protection objectives.

What You Will Do

Lead the deployment, adoption, and ongoing optimization of Asset Protection technology solutions across stores, supply chain facilities, and field organizations.
Manage a team of AP Technology Managers responsible for supporting technology programs, deployments, and operational execution across regional markets.
Partner with Asset Protection leadership to define technology priorities and align initiatives with strategic business objectives.
Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, and vendor solutions that support shortage reduction, investigative effectiveness, operational efficiency, and associate safety.
Oversee proof-of-concept testing, pilot programs, and operational evaluations to determine business value and implementation readiness.
Develop business cases, operational assessments, risk analyses, and recommendations supporting technology investment decisions.
Lead implementation planning, deployment strategies, communication plans, and adoption efforts for new AP technology solutions.
Partner with Macy's Technology teams to ensure effective integration, support, maintenance, and long-term sustainability of AP technology platforms.
Manage vendor relationships, service agreements, performance expectations, and contract deliverables to maximize solution effectiveness and value.
Oversee technology-related expense budgets and ensure responsible management of project and operational expenditures.
Monitor project progress, key milestones, implementation risks, and resource requirements to ensure successful execution.
Establish processes and governance that promote consistency, accountability, and operational excellence across AP technology programs.
Collaborate with Stores, Supply Chain, Fraud, Operations, Technology, and cross-functional business partners to identify opportunities for technology-driven improvements.
Support enterprise risk assessments and operational reviews related to security technology, investigative platforms, and AP operational capabilities.
Lead change management strategies that drive user adoption, engagement, and effective utilization of technology solutions.
Evaluate technology performance metrics and operational outcomes to identify enhancement opportunities and demonstrate business impact.
Develop and deliver executive summaries, status updates, and recommendations to Asset Protection and enterprise leadership teams.
Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.
In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

Skills You Will Need

Technology Strategy & Deployment:
Experience leading enterprise technology implementations, managing deployment activities, and driving successful adoption across diverse operational environments.

Leadership:
Ability to lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams while fostering collaboration, accountability, and professional growth.

Vendor Management:
Strong experience managing vendors, service providers, performance expectations, contracts, and strategic technology partnerships.

Project Management:
Ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives, coordinate stakeholders, mitigate risks, and deliver projects on schedule and within budget.

Business Partnership:
Ability to build strong relationships across Asset Protection, Operations, Technology, Supply Chain, and executive leadership teams.

Change Management:
Experience driving organizational adoption of new technology solutions through communication, training, and stakeholder engagement.

Strategic Thinking:
Ability to evaluate business needs, identify long-term opportunities, and align technology solutions with organizational goals.

Risk Assessment:
Knowledge of risk management principles, operational controls, and security technologies that support asset protection objectives.

Financial Acumen:
Experience managing budgets, evaluating business cases, measuring return on investment, and supporting informed technology decisions.

Communication:
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and present effectively to leadership audiences.

Problem-Solving:
Demonstrated ability to analyze complex business challenges and develop practical, scalable technology solutions.

Operational Excellence:
Ability to establish processes, standards, and governance models that improve consistency, efficiency, and performance.

Adaptability and Initiative:
Thrives in a fast-paced environment and effectively manages changing priorities, technology advancements, and evolving business needs.

Integrity and Professionalism:
Commitment to exemplifying the highest standards of ethics, confidentiality, and professional conduct.

Who You Are

Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Criminal Justice, Asset Protection, Technology Management, Operations, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience will also be considered.
5+ years of experience in Asset Protection, technology operations, systems implementation, project management, retail operations, or a related discipline.
3+ years of leadership experience managing teams, projects, or cross-functional technology initiatives.
Experience leading enterprise technology deployments and large-scale operational implementations.
Experience managing vendor relationships, technology contracts, and service delivery expectations.
Knowledge of retail technology solutions, video management systems, RFID technologies, investigative tools, analytics platforms, or related security technologies preferred.
Demonstrated success leading complex projects involving multiple stakeholders across business and technology organizations.
Strong analytical, financial, and business planning capabilities.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills with experience supporting executive-level decision making.
Proven ability to influence outcomes and build consensus across multiple business functions.
This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.
Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs, including travel as required.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

 Some Additional Benefits We Offer Include

Merchandise discounts
Performance-based incentives
Annual merit review
Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice
Tuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives. 

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

added.title: Senior Director, Technology Partnerships
added.description:
About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

USA - Remote

Canada - Remote

About The Role

Kinaxis is seeking a Senior Director, Technology Partnerships
to lead the strategy, development, and management of our technology partner ecosystem. This is a high-visibility leadership role responsible for identifying, negotiating, and scaling strategic relationships with hyperscalers, data providers, AI/ML platforms, and other complementary supply chain technology companies. You will work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Legal to build partnerships that drive incremental revenue, integrated solutions, expand market reach, and accelerate customer value.

This role is ideal for a strategic, relationship-driven leader with deep experience in enterprise software partnerships, technology alliances, or ecosystem development — ideally within supply chain, SCM, ERP, or related B2B SaaS domains.

What you will do

Develop the Partner Strategy: Define and execute a comprehensive technology partnership strategy aligned with Kinaxis' product roadmap, go-to-market priorities, and long-term business objectives. Leading with cloud and data/AI providers.
Develop the GTM and the Ecosystem: Identify, evaluate, and prioritize potential technology partners (cloud providers, AI/data platforms and other providers) to expand Kinaxis' GTM effectiveness, reach and enhance platform capabilities.
Deal Structuring & Negotiation: Lead commercial and technical negotiations for new partnerships, including co-development agreements, integration partnerships, and joint go-to-market arrangements.
Uplevel Relationship Management: Serve as the go-to-market point for key technology partners, cultivating trusted, long-term relationships at senior levels within partner organizations.
Drive Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to scope joint solutions, integrations, and roadmap alignment; collaborate with Sales and Marketing to build partner-driven pipeline and co-marketing programs as applicable.
Own Program Governance: Establish partnership frameworks, KPIs, and governance structures to measure technology partner performance, ROI, and strategic impact.
Market Intelligence: Monitor industry trends, emerging technologies (e.g., AI/ML, generative AI, cloud infrastructure), and competitive partnership landscapes to inform strategy.
Initiate Executive Communication: Report on partnership strategy, pipeline, and outcomes to senior leadership and the executive team.

How Success Is Measured

Partner Sourced Revenue Bookings or pipeline that can be directly attributed to a technology partner referral, joint solution or marketing event.
Partner Influenced Activities Volume and quality of specific high-value partner engagement actions including executive-to-executive introductions, joint customer briefings, marketplace transactions (e.g., Azure/GCP Marketplace), etc.

What we are looking for

10+ years of experience in technology partnerships, business development, strategic alliances, or related roles within enterprise B2B SaaS, supply chain, or ERP software companies.
Demonstrated success negotiating and managing complex, multi-stakeholder partnership agreements (technical, commercial, and legal dimensions).
Strong understanding of enterprise software ecosystems, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and data/AI technology partnerships.
Excellent executive presence, with experience engaging and influencing C-level stakeholders internally and at partner organizations.
Strategic thinker with strong analytical and business acumen; able to translate partnership opportunities into measurable business outcomes.
Commercially astute and analytically rigorous, able to connect partner capability and customer outcomes to growth and retention
Exceptional communication, negotiation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, or related field; MBA preferred.
Willingness to travel as needed (domestic/international).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in supply chain management, planning, or related enterprise software domains.
Familiarity with AI/ML technology partnerships and emerging supply chain AI ecosystems.
Built and scaled partnerships in the Microsoft and/or Google Cloud ecosystems
Existing network of relationships with data, or enterprise software providers.
Experience operating in a scale-up or high-growth SaaS environment.

#Director

Work With Impact:
Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands:
Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:
Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
Flexible work options
Physical and mental well-being programs
Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
Mentorship programs, training, and career development
Recognition programs and referral rewards
Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .

We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

added.title: Director, Data Engineering Analysis
added.description:
Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first. We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

The Director, Data Engineering Analysis is a hands-on analytical leader responsible for driving end-to-end data requirements, quality, and operational insight across our Medicare Advantage platform. This role works closely with operational, clinical, actuarial, and technology stakeholders to ensure data assets are accurate, trusted, and fit for decision-making at all levels of the organization. The Director leads the data analysis team, resolves production and customer-facing data issues, and champions continuous improvement in data quality and interoperability standards. Success in this role is measured by the reliability of data outputs, the speed and quality of issue resolution, and the team's ability to deliver trusted analytics that drive business outcomes.

Job Duties / Responsibilities

(May include but are not limited to)

Lead Data Requirements & Stakeholder Analysis — Partner with operational, analytical, and platform stakeholders to define, gather, and translate end-to-end data requirements into actionable specifications that meet both business and technical needs.
Drive Data Quality & Continuous Improvement — Initiate and sustain data quality improvement processes across health plan data domains, including claims, membership, member, and provider data, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
Own Data Operations & Issue Resolution — Direct the triage, analysis, and resolution of Data Ops issues affecting production environments and customer-facing outputs, minimizing disruption to plan operations.
Apply Healthcare Data Standards & Interoperability — Serve as the subject matter authority for EDI and healthcare data standards including X12 834/837 transactions, claims, membership, and provider domains, ensuring data interoperability across systems and partners.
Evaluate Data Sources for Completeness & Fitness — Assess internal and external data sources for quality, coverage, and suitability to support analytical, operational, and regulatory use cases across Medicare Advantage lines of business.
Enable the Data Platform — Apply working knowledge of cloud data platforms, streaming architectures, automation, and data quality as a service to support scalable, modern analytics infrastructure in partnership with data engineering.
Develop and Mentor the Data Analysis Team — Build team capability through active mentorship, coaching, and change leadership, fostering a culture of analytical rigor, intellectual curiosity, and continuous learning.

Fulfill supervisory responsibilities in accordance with organization policies and applicable laws. Job Requirements

8–10 years of progressive experience in data analysis, data operations, or data management roles, with at least 3 years in a leadership or senior individual contributor capacity.

Proven hands-on experience leading data requirements gathering and quality improvement across complex, multi-domain data environments.
Experience resolving production and operational data issues in regulated, time-sensitive environments.

Preferred:

Experience working within or alongside data platform and engineering teams in a cloud-based data ecosystem (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
Experience in a data analysis or data operations capacity supporting risk adjustment, HEDIS, Star Ratings, or encounter data submission workflows.
Experience building or scaling a data analysis team or function within a health plan or insurance organization.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Health Informatics, Statistics, or a related field.

Preferred:

Master's degree in Data Science, Health Informatics, Business Analytics, or a related discipline.

Demonstrated proficiency with SQL and at least one BI/reporting tool (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, SSRS) through work experience or equivalent training.

Preferred:

None.

added.title: Senior Director, Technology Partnerships
added.description:
About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

USA - Remote

Canada - Remote

About The Role

Kinaxis is seeking a Senior Director, Technology Partnerships
to lead the strategy, development, and management of our technology partner ecosystem. This is a high-visibility leadership role responsible for identifying, negotiating, and scaling strategic relationships with hyperscalers, data providers, AI/ML platforms, and other complementary supply chain technology companies. You will work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Legal to build partnerships that drive incremental revenue, integrated solutions, expand market reach, and accelerate customer value.

This role is ideal for a strategic, relationship-driven leader with deep experience in enterprise software partnerships, technology alliances, or ecosystem development — ideally within supply chain, SCM, ERP, or related B2B SaaS domains.

What you will do

Develop the Partner Strategy: Define and execute a comprehensive technology partnership strategy aligned with Kinaxis' product roadmap, go-to-market priorities, and long-term business objectives. Leading with cloud and data/AI providers.
Develop the GTM and the Ecosystem: Identify, evaluate, and prioritize potential technology partners (cloud providers, AI/data platforms and other providers) to expand Kinaxis' GTM effectiveness, reach and enhance platform capabilities.
Deal Structuring & Negotiation: Lead commercial and technical negotiations for new partnerships, including co-development agreements, integration partnerships, and joint go-to-market arrangements.
Uplevel Relationship Management: Serve as the go-to-market point for key technology partners, cultivating trusted, long-term relationships at senior levels within partner organizations.
Drive Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to scope joint solutions, integrations, and roadmap alignment; collaborate with Sales and Marketing to build partner-driven pipeline and co-marketing programs as applicable.
Own Program Governance: Establish partnership frameworks, KPIs, and governance structures to measure technology partner performance, ROI, and strategic impact.
Market Intelligence: Monitor industry trends, emerging technologies (e.g., AI/ML, generative AI, cloud infrastructure), and competitive partnership landscapes to inform strategy.
Initiate Executive Communication: Report on partnership strategy, pipeline, and outcomes to senior leadership and the executive team.

How Success Is Measured

Partner Sourced Revenue Bookings or pipeline that can be directly attributed to a technology partner referral, joint solution or marketing event.
Partner Influenced Activities Volume and quality of specific high-value partner engagement actions including executive-to-executive introductions, joint customer briefings, marketplace transactions (e.g., Azure/GCP Marketplace), etc.

What we are looking for

10+ years of experience in technology partnerships, business development, strategic alliances, or related roles within enterprise B2B SaaS, supply chain, or ERP software companies.
Demonstrated success negotiating and managing complex, multi-stakeholder partnership agreements (technical, commercial, and legal dimensions).
Strong understanding of enterprise software ecosystems, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and data/AI technology partnerships.
Excellent executive presence, with experience engaging and influencing C-level stakeholders internally and at partner organizations.
Strategic thinker with strong analytical and business acumen; able to translate partnership opportunities into measurable business outcomes.
Commercially astute and analytically rigorous, able to connect partner capability and customer outcomes to growth and retention
Exceptional communication, negotiation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, or related field; MBA preferred.
Willingness to travel as needed (domestic/international).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in supply chain management, planning, or related enterprise software domains.
Familiarity with AI/ML technology partnerships and emerging supply chain AI ecosystems.
Built and scaled partnerships in the Microsoft and/or Google Cloud ecosystems
Existing network of relationships with data, or enterprise software providers.
Experience operating in a scale-up or high-growth SaaS environment.

#Director

Work With Impact:
Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands:
Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:
Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
Flexible work options
Physical and mental well-being programs
Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
Mentorship programs, training, and career development
Recognition programs and referral rewards
Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .

Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

added.description:
About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

USA - Remote

Canada - Remote

About The Role

Kinaxis is seeking a Senior Director, Technology Partnerships
to lead the strategy, development, and management of our technology partner ecosystem. This is a high-visibility leadership role responsible for identifying, negotiating, and scaling strategic relationships with hyperscalers, data providers, AI/ML platforms, and other complementary supply chain technology companies. You will work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Legal to build partnerships that drive incremental revenue, integrated solutions, expand market reach, and accelerate customer value.

This role is ideal for a strategic, relationship-driven leader with deep experience in enterprise software partnerships, technology alliances, or ecosystem development — ideally within supply chain, SCM, ERP, or related B2B SaaS domains.

What you will do

Develop the Partner Strategy: Define and execute a comprehensive technology partnership strategy aligned with Kinaxis' product roadmap, go-to-market priorities, and long-term business objectives. Leading with cloud and data/AI providers.
Develop the GTM and the Ecosystem: Identify, evaluate, and prioritize potential technology partners (cloud providers, AI/data platforms and other providers) to expand Kinaxis' GTM effectiveness, reach and enhance platform capabilities.
Deal Structuring & Negotiation: Lead commercial and technical negotiations for new partnerships, including co-development agreements, integration partnerships, and joint go-to-market arrangements.
Uplevel Relationship Management: Serve as the go-to-market point for key technology partners, cultivating trusted, long-term relationships at senior levels within partner organizations.
Drive Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to scope joint solutions, integrations, and roadmap alignment; collaborate with Sales and Marketing to build partner-driven pipeline and co-marketing programs as applicable.
Own Program Governance: Establish partnership frameworks, KPIs, and governance structures to measure technology partner performance, ROI, and strategic impact.
Market Intelligence: Monitor industry trends, emerging technologies (e.g., AI/ML, generative AI, cloud infrastructure), and competitive partnership landscapes to inform strategy.
Initiate Executive Communication: Report on partnership strategy, pipeline, and outcomes to senior leadership and the executive team.

Partner Sourced Revenue Bookings or pipeline that can be directly attributed to a technology partner referral, joint solution or marketing event.

Demonstrated success negotiating and managing complex, multi-stakeholder partnership agreements (technical, commercial, and legal dimensions).
Strong understanding of enterprise software ecosystems, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and data/AI technology partnerships.
Excellent executive presence, with experience engaging and influencing C-level stakeholders internally and at partner organizations.
Strategic thinker with strong analytical and business acumen; able to translate partnership opportunities into measurable business outcomes.
Commercially astute and analytically rigorous, able to connect partner capability and customer outcomes to growth and retention
Exceptional communication, negotiation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, or related field; MBA preferred.
Willingness to travel as needed (domestic/international).

Familiarity with AI/ML technology partnerships and emerging supply chain AI ecosystems.
Built and scaled partnerships in the Microsoft and/or Google Cloud ecosystems
Existing network of relationships with data, or enterprise software providers.

added.description:
Who We Are

Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at <a href="https://www.accenture.com/" target="_blank" data-cmp-clickable="" data-cmp-data-layer="{"jobdetail-1e0b7e5710-Job Description-item0":{"analytics-link-name":"accenture.com","analytics-link-type":"engagement","xdm:linkURL":"https://www.accenture.com/","analytics-engagement":"true"}}" rel="noopener noreferrer">accenture.com.

We are Accenture’s Supply Chain and Engineering reinvention partner for Life Sciences. We embed innovation, intelligence, and AI-native operations into the way the world designs, engineers, manufactures, and distributes products. We serve Life Sciences clients across the value chain to help bring lifesaving medicines and products to patients through harnessing the power of advanced technologies.

The Work

Accenture is seeking a Senior Manager to lead Core Supply Chain transformation work within our Supply Chain & Engineering practice for Life Sciences. This executive will serve as a trusted advisor to C suite and operations leaders, helping clients plan, implement, and evolve on the SAP platform.

The role is responsible for shaping, selling, and delivering large scale Transformation programs backed by SAP. The Senior Manager will assess growth, build client relationships, drive origination and own end to end delivery while building Accenture’s SAP delivery excellence capability.

Key Responsibilities

Client Leadership & Growth

Serve as a trusted advisor to C suite, operations, and technology leaders, guiding SAP S4/HANA transformation projects for Supply Chain from conceptual design through hypercare.
Build and expand executive relationships across priority accounts, driving sustained growth and value realization.
Navigate complex stakeholder environments with multiple competing priorities, aligning diverse groups around a shared transformation vision and maintaining trust under pressure.
Synthesize ambiguous client situations into clear, actionable strategic direction, translating complexity into narratives that resonate at the board level and drive decisions.
Anticipate client needs before they surface, proactively shaping the agenda and positioning Accenture as a strategic partner rather than a transactional vendor.
Support client sales origination and develop thought leadership, points of view, and go-to-market assets that differentiate Accenture's Planning offering.

SAP Program Leadership

Lead end to end SAP programs for Life Sciences Supply Shain and Manufacturing
Oversee complex, multi-partner delivery managing through influence, not just authority, to keep diverse teams aligned and accountable.
Apply structured problem-solving and systems thinking to break down large transformation challenges into sequenced, manageable workstreams with clear ownership and milestones.
Exercise sound judgment and decisive leadership when navigating delivery risk, scope ambiguity, or shifting client priorities escalating and course-correcting proactively.
Own financial performance, delivery excellence, and risk management across the portfolio with transparency and disciplined execution.

SAP Transformation

Sell and deliver major transformation programs while serving as a techno-functional subject matter advisor, bringing deep expertise and perspective on SAP functionality for Supply Chain and Manufacturing operations in Life Sciences
Spot and solve challenges using your analytical & strategy skills to dive into data and compare vs. industry peers
Assist with workshops that look for ways to improve organizations and processes through effective SAP enablement
Determine what methods and procedures to use when completing projects
Give clients insights that help make their companies work better, faster, and more efficiently     
Challenge legacy ways of working using constructive techniques that fuel client growth
Lead large teams with diverse backgrounds skills and knowledge
Support client sales origination and thought leadership development
Use the latest analytical tools and digital tech to help clients find new ways to understand how to make their organizations more effective and efficient

Practice & Talent Leadership

Build, mentor, and inspire high performing SAP transformation teams across adjacent practices.
Own financial performance, delivery excellence, and risk management across the portfolio.
Lead through ambiguity: set clear direction when the path forward is uncertain, model intellectual humility, and cultivate a team culture of curiosity, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Coach and develop junior and mid-level talent with intention not just delegating tasks, but actively building capability, confidence, and career trajectory across the team.
Contribute to capability development, reusable assets, and go to market offerings for SAP for Supply Chain and Manufacturing specific to the Life Sciences industry.

Travel Requirements

Travel is required for this role and could vary up to 75%

Here's What You Need

Minimum 8 years executive leadership experience delivering SAP programs, ideally within consulting or professional services environments
Expertise across SAP S4/HANA suite of technology solutions including Life Sciences specific co-innovation modules
Demonstrated experience leading project workstreams or client engagements, including managing and developing junior staff
Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If associate degree, must have a minimum of 6 years’ work experience)

Bonus Points If

Demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships with senior clients, influence without authority, and navigate complex organizational dynamics with emotional intelligence and executive presence
Depth of knowledge around data and AI concepts
Proven ability to structure ambiguous problems, apply analytical rigor, and synthesize complex information into clear strategic recommendations
Strong commercial instincts — ability to identify growth opportunities, shape client agendas, and contribute meaningfully to sales origination and offering development
Track record of applying systems thinking across large, cross-functional transformation programs where no single lever solves the problem alone
Experience facilitating senior leadership workshops and driving alignment across diverse stakeholder groups with competing interests
Ability to read organizational dynamics quickly and adapt — knowing when to push for change and when to build consensus first
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical recommendations into compelling narratives for diverse audiences, from operators to the C-suite
Comfortable presenting in high-stakes settings and experienced at using storytelling to create momentum for difficult organizational change
Track record of coaching and growing talent — building capability and career trajectory, not just delivering against project milestones
Experience building high-performing teams and contributing to practice or capability development beyond individual project delivery
Ability to lead through ambiguity, model accountability, and foster a team culture grounded in intellectual curiosity and continuous improvement
Hybrid experience in both consulting and Life Sciences industry

added.title: Director, Engineering - Oahu, Maui, Hawaii Island
added.description:
We recognize our competitive advantage -- our people. We believe in our people, who share our vision of meeting the needs of our employees, customers, and communities and who carry out the continued success of the company.

Our employees are committed to the company's foundational values: integrity, excellence, teamwork, environmental stewardship, and community commitment. In turn, we invest in our employees, providing opportunities for challenge and advancement and offering a competitive compensation package.

Applications will be screened based on the information provided; in order to assist us in determining qualifications, please upload a current resume and take some time to update your employment information, certifications, etc. The information will flow over to your profile.

Posting End Date: This position will remain open until filled. Early applications are highly encouraged.

Brief Posting Description

The H BC ENGINEERING ADMIN Department of the H ENGINEERING Division at Hawaiian Electric Company has 1 Management vacancy available. This position may be filled on Oahu, Maui, or Hawaii Island. (Role: Director)

Job Function

Provides strategic leadership and oversight for engineering functions supporting the Company’s transmission, distribution, substation, grid modernization and customer engineering programs. Manages engineering resources and ensures the safe, reliable, compliant, and cost-effective design of utility infrastructure in alignment with the Company’s goals.

Essential Functions

Establishes and executes Division’s engineering strategy, long-range plans, priorities, policies, technical standards, and performance objectives in alignment with the Company’s strategy. Establishes policies, standards, and procedures that ensure the financial and regulatory compliance requirements of the Company, government agencies and utility stakeholders.
Develops operating forecasts and manages Division staffing to meet present and forecasted needs. Ensures efficient utilization of internal and external engineering resources in order to execute the Energy Delivery capital expenditure plans and deliver timely solutions for customer requests.
Leads operational excellence, continuous improvement, innovation and organizational change across the Division. to achieve goals and maintain a high-performing workforce. Establish performance measures, evaluates organizational effectiveness and implements corrective strategies to improve engineering quality, productivity, accountability, and business results
Builds leadership and organizational capability by establishing workforce, talent-development, succession, and performance-management strategies. Develops subordinate leaders and technical professionals and fosters a culture of safety, accountability, inclusion, recognition, collaboration, and high performance.
Represents the Division in executive, regulatory, governmental, community, and cross-functional matters. Influences enterprise decisions, communicates engineering strategies and risks, and establishes partnerships necessary to advance Company objectives and coordinate complex utility initiatives.
Participates in Company emergency response activities as assigned, including any activities required to prepare for such emergency response.

Basic Qualifications

Knowledge Requirements

Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited engineering program. Advanced degree in engineering, business administration or closely related field is desirable.
Thorough knowledge of electric power engineering principles and utility practices applicable to transmission, distribution, substations, system protection, customer engineering, grid planning and the integration of generation and distributed engineering resources.
Thorough knowledge of engineering design, construction, commissioning, operations support, technical standards, design assurance, quality management, and lifecycle management of electric utility assets.
Thorough knowledge of the regulated electric utility business including federal, state, and local laws, regulatory proceedings, reliability and safety environmental and permitting considerations; and financial and internal-control requirements.
Thorough knowledge of capital and O&M planning, portfolio prioritization, budgeting, forecasting, cost control, contracting, procurement, resource planning, and governance of complex engineering programs.
Thorough knowledge of grid modernization, resilience, reliability, emergency preparedness, advanced grid technologies, and the operational implications of cyber and physical security requirements.
Thorough knowledge of project and program management standards and methodologies for leading complex capital, operational, and strategic initiatives, including project lifecycle management, scope and risk management, work planning, resource coordination, and performance monitoring, typically acquired through formal training and extensive professional experience.
Knowledge of general procurement policies, processes, responsibilities.
Working knowledge of land rights, easements, permits, site acquisition, labor relations, collective bargaining agreements, and contractor management as applicable to utility engineering activities.
Broad management and leadership knowledge to lead teams across different disciplines.
Thorough knowledge of leadership and change management methodologies and practices typically acquired through formal training (i.e. leadership training, Lean Leadership, ADKAR Change Management, etc.) and experience .
Working knowledge of SafeStart principles and best practices to achieve a safe workplace environment.
Working knowledge of the union contract and managing union employees.
Working knowledge of business process improvement and reengineering systems.
Working knowledge of financial controls and regulatory requirements (i.e. SOX, PUC, etc.).
Working knowledge of personal computers and related software applications (i.e., spreadsheets, word processing, databasemanagement, etc.).

Skills Requirements

Demonstrated effective written, verbal and listening communication skills through all levels of the Company including strong presentation skills and ability to participate in public speaking functions.
Strong analytical, organizational, and conceptual skills to recommend appropriate actions and manage simultaneously a variety of projects, programs, and assignments.
Ability to remain flexible in a demanding work environment and to adapt to rapidly changing priorities.
Ability to make good decisions quickly and with limited information, to monitor results, and to refine or revise decisions based on observed outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to build effective working relationships with business leaders, customers, and stakeholders at all levels.
Demonstrated ability to lead a team of professionals through challenging times to successful outcomes.
Demonstrated interpersonal skills to handle confrontational, difficult and/or sensitive issues.
Ability to handle such issues with professionalism while using tact, courtesy, and discretion.
Must have or be able to qualify for a current State of Hawaii driver’s license to conduct on-site surveys/inspections of projects. Must meet the requirements for required driving positions as stated in the Hiring Standards for Required Company Drivers policy.
Must be able to fly between islands on a regular basis.

Experience Requirements

Extensive (10+) years of progressively responsible engineering experience, including substantial experience in a regulated electric utility or comparable power-sector environment.
Extensive (7+) years of progressively responsible leadership experience directing engineering professionals and technical leaders.
Demonstrated experience overseeing major capital and O&M programs, engineering standards, resource planning, budgeting, regulatory or stakeholder matters, and delivery of complex utility infrastructure.
State of Hawaii Professional Electrical Engineer License.
Experience leading engineering functions across multiple locations or operating companies and supporting emergency response is highly desirable.

Role
: Director

Number of Vacancies
: 1

Location
: This position may be filled on Oahu, Maui, or Hawaii Island.

Hiring Range
: The hiring range for the Dir, Engineering [Req ID 10650] position is $159,400.00 to $211,400.00. The person selected will be placed according to his/her skills and qualifications.

About Hawaiian Electric Companies

Hawaiian Electric Companies provide electricity and services to 95 percent of the state's 1.4 million residents. The company is also one of the state's leading employers and a major contributor and supporter of community and educational programs.

The demand for power that has fueled the growth of the Hawaiian Islands has been met by Hawaiian Electric Companies for well over a century. And as the next millennium unfolds, the company is committed to providing quality service and seeking clean local energy sources to power generations of Hawaii families and businesses to come. Visit us at http://hawaiianelectric.com .

Interested individuals should apply online. The application must clearly indicate the demonstrated experience/knowledge/skills/abilities the candidate possesses which specifically qualifies him/her for the position.

Applicant Certification

Authorize and consent to, without reservation, the Hawaiian Electric Companies sharing any and all information regarding previous or present employment, educational training or personal information from their records and from any other source with the hiring department or subsidiary company;
