These investigations may include, but are not limited to searches for information about applicants; record of criminal convictions to the extent permitted by law, education records, professional certifications, personal character references, and employment history.

EEO Statement

Hawaiian Electric Companies is an equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

Hawaiian Electric Companies complies with all applicable laws, including Title I of the Americans with Disabilities Act. Any request for reasonable accommodation needed during the application process should be communicated by the candidate to the HR Service Center at (808) 543-4848.

Affiliate Disclaimer

The relationship between Hawaiian Electric and unregulated, energy-related affiliate companies is governed by the Affiliate Transaction Requirements (ATRs) established by the Hawaii Public Utilities Commission (PUC). The ATRs were established with the PUC's Decision and Order No. 35962 issued on December 19, 2018, and subsequently modified by Order No. 36112, issued on January 24, 2019, in Docket No. 2018-0065. With Decision and Order No. 42409, issued on March 23, 2026, in Docket No. 2025-0391, the PUC indefinitely suspended certain sections of the ATRs.

The ATRs address many issues related to Hawaiian Electric's interactions and transactions with Affiliates and Affiliate-Related Entities. If you'd like more information about these rules/regulations, you can email ATR@hawaiianelectric.c

added.title: Head of Technology
added.description:
About MeeBoss

MeeBoss is a high-impact, agile team re-imagining the recruitment landscape by restoring human connection to the earliest stages of hiring. Our platform integrates sophisticated job-matching with direct, real-time communication, empowering organizations to identify and engage top-tier talent with greater speed and cost-efficiency. By bridging the gap between personalized matching and immediate interaction, we enable both employers and seekers to evaluate fit and accelerate hiring outcomes with confidence.
As a rapidly scaling startup, MeeBoss is transforming how companies and candidates connect online. Our mission is to modernize recruitment through a seamless, tech-forward experience that facilitates direct engagement with job-ready individuals. By leveraging intelligent matching and innovative technology, we help businesses attract and hire exceptional talent more effectively, delivering a differentiated and highly personalized experience across the entire hiring lifecycle.

About the Role

We are looking for a Head of Technology to lead MeeBoss’s Engineering and Algorithm teams and shape the technical foundation for our next stage of growth.
This role is particularly focused on search, recommendation, ranking, matching, and personalization. We are looking for a technical leader with strong experience in search, recommendation, or advertising systems who can connect algorithms, engineering, product experience, and business outcomes.
You will work closely with Product, Data, Design, and business teams to turn product ideas and user behavior into scalable technical solutions. As MeeBoss grows, this role has the potential to expand into broader ownership of the company’s overall technology strategy and organization.

What You’ll Do

Lead Algorithm & AI Capabilities
• Set the direction for MeeBoss’s matching, recommendation, ranking, search, and personalization capabilities.
• Improve how candidates, jobs, and employers are understood, matched, ranked, and surfaced.
• Connect algorithm development with user behavior, product metrics, and business outcomes.
• Establish effective metrics and experimentation frameworks to evaluate algorithm performance.
• Guide the integration of ML, LLMs, embeddings, and other AI technologies where they create meaningful product value.
Build & Lead the Technology Team
• Build, lead, and develop our Engineering and Algorithm teams.
• Recruit strong engineers, algorithm specialists, and technical leaders as the company scales.
• Set clear priorities, ownership, and expectations across technical teams.
• Mentor technical talent and build a culture of ownership, speed, quality, and continuous improvement.
Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Partner closely with Product, Data, Design, Operations, and business teams to translate product and business needs into technical solutions.
• Bring technical and algorithmic perspectives into product strategy, planning, and prioritization.
• Establish clear ownership, priorities, requirements, and dependencies across teams.
• Work through ambiguity and changing priorities while keeping teams aligned on shared goals.
• Identify cross-functional issues early, bring the right stakeholders together, and drive decisions toward execution.
• Communicate technical opportunities, constraints, and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Drive Technology & Execution
• Provide technical leadership across backend systems, APIs, data infrastructure, architecture, and scalable application development.
• Ensure algorithm and AI capabilities are effectively integrated into production systems.
• Make practical tradeoffs across speed, scalability, technical quality, and business priorities.
• Identify technical risks and dependencies early and drive them toward resolution.
• Help new products and technical capabilities move effectively from 0→1 to production.

What We’re Looking For

• 8–10+ years of experience in algorithms, machine learning, search, recommendation, advertising, or related technical areas.
• Strong experience with search, recommendation, ranking, advertising algorithms, matching, or personalization systems.
• Proven experience building and operating algorithmic or ML systems in production.
• Strong understanding of backend systems, APIs, databases, data infrastructure, system architecture, and cloud environments.
• Experience leading Engineering, Algorithm, ML, or multidisciplinary technical teams.
• Experience building products, systems, or technical capabilities from 0→1.

added.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is building the data and AI platform for the agentic enterprise. Enterprise Apps & Agentic Systems is applying that same standard internally by redesigning business domains from first principles and turning high-value workflows into software-defined, AI-native products.

We are hiring a Sr. Director to make Finance, OTC, Revenue, People, and Legal domains more agentic. This leader will own the product and engineering strategy across the portfolio, moving beyond application management to deliver intelligent products that understand context, act across systems, operate within guardrails, and involve people when judgment is required.

This leader will work directly with business executives to identify the work that should be eliminated, redesigned, or delegated to software. They will build the teams, product model, technical foundations, and operating mechanisms needed to move quickly from opportunity to production and deliver measurable business impact

CORE MISSION:

Transform enterprise operations across Finance, People, and Legal by redesigning end-to-end workflows into AI-native products rather than adding incremental features to legacy apps.
Combine domain expertise, enterprise data, workflow automation, autonomous agents, and controls into a coherent operating experience.
Establish a product-led model where cross-functional teams co-own strategy, adoption, reliability, and business impact.
Build a scalable AI product lifecycle to rapidly prototype, evaluate, deploy, and scale intelligent agents across the organization.

Define and execute the multi-year product and engineering roadmap across Finance, HR, and Legal domains, aligning investments with high-value business outcomes.
Partner with C-level and executive leaders (CFO, HR, Legal) to challenge existing processes and redesign future-state operating models.
Deliver production-grade agents and AI-native workflows that use trusted context and enterprise tools to complete multi-step work, manage exceptions, and escalate with clear explanations and auditability.
Establish a product-led operating model in which business and technology co-own the problem, product strategy, adoption, reliability, controls, and value realized.
Establish software architecture and engineering standards for AI products, covering orchestration, context retrieval, tool integration, safety, compliance, latency, and cost.
Build reusable AI patterns and modular platforms to enable fast deployment of agentic capabilities without building bespoke platforms for every use case.
Lead cross-functional product pods accountable for adoption, workflow completion, and measurable value realization.
Ensure AI implementations maintain rigorous governance, auditability, SOX controls, data privacy, and security standards.
Define operational metrics to track agentic transformation, including automation rates, cycle-time reductions, exception management, and ROI.
Hire, mentor, and scale a world-class product and engineering team with strong AI fluency, business empathy, and operational excellence.
Manage portfolio budgets, vendor strategies, and technology partnerships to accelerate business outcomes.

15+ years of experience in enterprise technology, product management, or software engineering, with 5+ years leading multi-disciplinary organizations at the Director level or above.

First-principles product mindset focused on simplifying workflows, rapid prototyping, outcome ownership, and user-centric design.
Experience building product-led organizations with empowered teams, managing managers, and setting a high talent bar across product, program, engineering, and domain leadership.
Experience moving quickly from ambiguity to a working product, learning from usage, simplifying fragmented landscapes, and making hard prioritization decisions based on business value.

added.description:
At Henderson, We're About More Than Just Buildings

We're about the people, experiences, and longevity of a building. We’re a company of problem-solvers and innovators known for our technical excellence and ability to provide come up with out-of-the-box solutions when it comes to design and construction. We love the process of bringing buildings to life – and keeping them in shape long after the doors open.

As an ESOP, each of our employee-owners are an essential part of our mission to lead the industry in innovation, sustainability, and client experience. With a vision to build a better world, Team Henderson has a people-first culture and diverse portfolio of world-class facilities.

It's What We Do

We provide total building system design and construction services across multiple high-growth markets throughout the country for industry leaders. You'll get to use your talent to work on projects for some of the biggest names in mission-critical, higher education, sports, healthcare, grocery, restaurant, and retail within the sectors we serve in business, community, grocery, health, retail, and venue.

It's How We're Different

We're about more than just buildings. We're about you. You, and the hundreds of passionate employee-owners who make us who we are. We’ve always been committed to providing an inclusive workplace where people can bring their full self to work and helps people reach their full potential – both as professionals and individuals. Posted Thursday, September 10th, 2026 | Expires Thursday, December 10th, 2026

Position Summary

The Sr Building Technology Systems Director acts as the national business leader for Building Technology Systems (BTS), a Strategic Growth Services business unit responsible for operational technology (OT) systems integration consulting, cybersecurity consulting specific to operational technology, telecommunications design consulting, electronic safety and security design consulting. Providing leadership in the development of building technology strategies that meet an owner's business and operational needs. The Sr Building Technology Systems Director sets the strategic direction for the company, manages investment decisions, and drives innovation across all service lines. Accountable for establishing, scaling, and leading the national Building Technology Systems practice, including business performance, talent strategy, technical excellence, and market growth.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, security management, or a related field required. Master's degree or higher in fields related to building technology, cybersecurity, or business administration is preferred.
Minimum of 15 years of relevant experience across telecommunications design, electronic safety and security design, operational technology, OT cybersecurity, or physical security consulting required, with at least 7 years in a leadership or management role with a proven track record of technical excellence, business unit growth, and strategic influence preferred.
Relevant experience in providing consultancy services to building owners and operators across Building Technology Systems is required.
Advanced knowledge of telecommunications infrastructure, electronic safety and security systems and operational technology principles required.
Proficiency in network design, OT/IT network architecture, and solutions architecture required.
Relevant certifications, such as PE, RCDD, CISSP, PSP, or CPP, reflecting depth of expertise across the BTS service lines required preferred.
Experience with integrated building management systems (IBMS), building automation systems (BAS), SCADA systems, access control and video surveillance platforms, and premise/outside plant telecommunications infrastructure required.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity practices and risk assessment methodologies specific to operational technology environments preferred.
Familiarity with industry standards and regulations (e.g., NIST, IEC 62443, ISO 27001, BICSI, TIA/EIA, NFPA 730/731, UL 2050, NEC, IBC) required.
Proficiency with relevant software tools, including Bluebeam Revu, network/security design platforms, and Microsoft Office Suite required.

Essential Job Functions & Accountabilities

Strategic Leadership & Management:

Lead annual internal business planning and strategy sessions to set growth goals.
Develop and execute the financial strategy to meet financial and performance goals.
Provide strategic direction to the company around Building Technology Systems, shaping organizational goals, growth targets, execution plans, and investment strategies to advance the company's position in the industry.
Develop and enforce policies, procedures, and standards related to building technology systems, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and corporate guidelines.
Collaborate with sector and organizational leadership to align building technology systems approaches with company-wide strategies and initiatives

Building Technology Strategy & Innovation

Drive innovation in Building Technology Systems by staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies.
Evaluate and recommend new technologies and methodologies to enhance the company's service offerings and competitive edge.
Develop long-term strategy for the adoption and integration of advanced building technology systems within the company's projects and services.
Represent the company in industry forums and thought leadership activities to promote its expertise in Building Technology Systems.

Building Technology Solutions

Oversee the identification and quantification of problems experienced by building operators and owners.
Lead the team in gathering stakeholder needs and synthesizing them into clear, actionable visions.
Coordinate Building Technology Systems with building owners, owner representatives, General Contractor teams, and Commissioning agents.
Promote, educate, and consult on the integration of intelligent building systems to enhance overall building performance and client value.
Lead the development and implementation of consulting strategies specific to operational technology environments.
Evaluate, validate, and select appropriate vendor platforms and tools that meet solution needs.

Client Relations & Business Development

Leverage opportunities and relationships internally across Henderson Companies and externally across the industry to develop business growth.
Lead the development, establishment, and maintenance of relationships with strategic partners and customers in support of and to expand business opportunities.
Lead and provide input on client engagement strategies, project pursuits, and project execution.
Represent Henderson Companies at client, company, and/or industry events to build and maintain professional relationships.
Drive collaboration with HEI sectors and HBS teams to develop, define, and execute company-wide strategies.
Earn the trust of senior leaders at client organizations and partner with them to create strategic solutions at the intersection of business, technology infrastructure, cybersecurity, physical safety & security, and facility operations.
Build relationships with clients to raise Henderson Companies' profile as long-term trusted advisor and partner.
Develop and strengthen the Building Technology Systems business and role as a thought leader by creating content and taking part in professional forums, both internal and external.
Resolve conflicts involving clients, architects, contractors, and facility managers related to building technology systems matters.
Align technical execution to streamline client experience and maximize client satisfaction.

Team Leadership & Technical Excellence

Establish goal planning for team members and conduct recurring check-ins.
Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement within the team and organization.
Demonstrate an organization-wide mindset, cooperating across sector and operations teams to collectively meet organizational goals.
Mentor and develop staff to build a strong succession pipeline across the Building Technology Systems disciplines.
Ensure technical execution aligns with organization-wide technical expertise and capabilities.
Empower team members to deal with ambiguity and maintain consistent standards of service and results.
Engage resources in response to areas in need of improvement, fostering a culture of quality.

The Opportunity

As a SAP Technology and D&A Director, you will lead the charge in optimizing operational efficiency for our clients by analyzing their needs, implementing software solutions, and providing comprehensive training and support. Within our Digital Core Modernisation network, you will specialize in utilizing and managing SAP software and solutions, focusing on installation, configuration, administration, development, and support of SAP products and technologies. As a Director, you will set the strategic direction and lead business development efforts, making impactful decisions and overseeing multiple projects while maintaining executive-level client relations. Translating the vision, you set the tone and inspire others to follow, driving business growth and shaping the direction of client engagements.

In this role at PwC, you will be a guardian of our reputation, understanding that quality, integrity, inclusion, and a commercial mindset are foundational to our success. You will create a healthy working environment while maximizing client satisfaction and cultivating the potential in others. By actively teaming across the PwC Network, you will leverage our collective strength to identify market gaps and convert opportunities into success for the firm.

Responsibilities

Leading strategic direction and business development efforts within SAP technology consulting
Overseeing installation, configuration, and administration of SAP products and technologies
Managing client engagements to optimize operational efficiency and achieve strategic objectives
Implementing software solutions and providing training for seamless integration of business applications
Utilizing SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori to enhance data visualization and insights generation
Promoting technological advances and fostering environments where people and technology thrive together
Identifying market gaps and converting opportunities into successful outcomes for the firm
Developing new ideas and solutions to drive thought leadership and innovation
Balancing long-term and short-term strategic thinking to address system-level enablers
Cultivating potential in others through mentorship and leadership across the PwC Network

What You Must Have

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 9 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

Preference for a Master's or Masters of Business Administration degree in at least one of the following fields of study: Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems, Engineering
Demonstrating proficiency in SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori
Utilizing Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) for business transformation
Leading strategic technology planning and systemic thinking initiatives
Excelling in strategic questioning and innovation for client solutions
Cultivating potential through coaching and feedback within teams
Promoting technological advances in SAP environments

Posted Thursday, September 10th, 2026 | Expires Thursday, December 10th, 2026

Position Summary

The Sr Building Technology Systems Director acts as the national business leader for Building Technology Systems (BTS), a Strategic Growth Services business unit responsible for operational technology (OT) systems integration consulting, cybersecurity consulting specific to operational technology, telecommunications design consulting, electronic safety and security design consulting. Providing leadership in the development of building technology strategies that meet an owner's business and operational needs. The Sr Building Technology Systems Director sets the strategic direction for the company, manages investment decisions, and drives innovation across all service lines. Accountable for establishing, scaling, and leading the national Building Technology Systems practice, including business performance, talent strategy, technical excellence, and market growth.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, security management, or a related field required. Master's degree or higher in fields related to building technology, cybersecurity, or business administration is preferred.
Minimum of 15 years of relevant experience across telecommunications design, electronic safety and security design, operational technology, OT cybersecurity, or physical security consulting required, with at least 7 years in a leadership or management role with a proven track record of technical excellence, business unit growth, and strategic influence preferred.
Relevant experience in providing consultancy services to building owners and operators across Building Technology Systems is required.
Advanced knowledge of telecommunications infrastructure, electronic safety and security systems and operational technology principles required.
Proficiency in network design, OT/IT network architecture, and solutions architecture required.
Relevant certifications, such as PE, RCDD, CISSP, PSP, or CPP, reflecting depth of expertise across the BTS service lines required preferred.
Experience with integrated building management systems (IBMS), building automation systems (BAS), SCADA systems, access control and video surveillance platforms, and premise/outside plant telecommunications infrastructure required.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity practices and risk assessment methodologies specific to operational technology environments preferred.
Familiarity with industry standards and regulations (e.g., NIST, IEC 62443, ISO 27001, BICSI, TIA/EIA, NFPA 730/731, UL 2050, NEC, IBC) required.
Proficiency with relevant software tools, including Bluebeam Revu, network/security design platforms, and Microsoft Office Suite required.

Essential Job Functions & Accountabilities

Strategic Leadership & Management:

Lead annual internal business planning and strategy sessions to set growth goals.
Develop and execute the financial strategy to meet financial and performance goals.
Provide strategic direction to the company around Building Technology Systems, shaping organizational goals, growth targets, execution plans, and investment strategies to advance the company's position in the industry.
Develop and enforce policies, procedures, and standards related to building technology systems, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and corporate guidelines.
Collaborate with sector and organizational leadership to align building technology systems approaches with company-wide strategies and initiatives

Building Technology Strategy & Innovation

Drive innovation in Building Technology Systems by staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies.
Evaluate and recommend new technologies and methodologies to enhance the company's service offerings and competitive edge.
Develop long-term strategy for the adoption and integration of advanced building technology systems within the company's projects and services.
Represent the company in industry forums and thought leadership activities to promote its expertise in Building Technology Systems.

Building Technology Solutions

Oversee the identification and quantification of problems experienced by building operators and owners.
Lead the team in gathering stakeholder needs and synthesizing them into clear, actionable visions.
Coordinate Building Technology Systems with building owners, owner representatives, General Contractor teams, and Commissioning agents.
Promote, educate, and consult on the integration of intelligent building systems to enhance overall building performance and client value.
Lead the development and implementation of consulting strategies specific to operational technology environments.
Evaluate, validate, and select appropriate vendor platforms and tools that meet solution needs.

Client Relations & Business Development

Leverage opportunities and relationships internally across Henderson Companies and externally across the industry to develop business growth.
Lead the development, establishment, and maintenance of relationships with strategic partners and customers in support of and to expand business opportunities.
Lead and provide input on client engagement strategies, project pursuits, and project execution.
Represent Henderson Companies at client, company, and/or industry events to build and maintain professional relationships.
Drive collaboration with HEI sectors and HBS teams to develop, define, and execute company-wide strategies.
Earn the trust of senior leaders at client organizations and partner with them to create strategic solutions at the intersection of business, technology infrastructure, cybersecurity, physical safety & security, and facility operations.
Build relationships with clients to raise Henderson Companies' profile as long-term trusted advisor and partner.
Develop and strengthen the Building Technology Systems business and role as a thought leader by creating content and taking part in professional forums, both internal and external.
Resolve conflicts involving clients, architects, contractors, and facility managers related to building technology systems matters.
Align technical execution to streamline client experience and maximize client satisfaction.

Team Leadership & Technical Excellence

Establish goal planning for team members and conduct recurring check-ins.
Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement within the team and organization.
Demonstrate an organization-wide mindset, cooperating across sector and operations teams to collectively meet organizational goals.
Mentor and develop staff to build a strong succession pipeline across the Building Technology Systems disciplines.
Ensure technical execution aligns with organization-wide technical expertise and capabilities.
Empower team members to deal with ambiguity and maintain consistent standards of service and results.
Engage resources in response to areas in need of improvement, fostering a culture of quality.

added.description:
The Opportunity

As a SAP Technology and D&A Director, you will lead the charge in optimizing operational efficiency for our clients by analyzing their needs, implementing software solutions, and providing comprehensive training and support. Within our Digital Core Modernisation network, you will specialize in utilizing and managing SAP software and solutions, focusing on installation, configuration, administration, development, and support of SAP products and technologies. As a Director, you will set the strategic direction and lead business development efforts, making impactful decisions and overseeing multiple projects while maintaining executive-level client relations. Translating the vision, you set the tone and inspire others to follow, driving business growth and shaping the direction of client engagements.

In this role at PwC, you will be a guardian of our reputation, understanding that quality, integrity, inclusion, and a commercial mindset are foundational to our success. You will create a healthy working environment while maximizing client satisfaction and cultivating the potential in others. By actively teaming across the PwC Network, you will leverage our collective strength to identify market gaps and convert opportunities into success for the firm.

Responsibilities

Leading strategic direction and business development efforts within SAP technology consulting
Overseeing installation, configuration, and administration of SAP products and technologies
Managing client engagements to optimize operational efficiency and achieve strategic objectives
Implementing software solutions and providing training for seamless integration of business applications
Utilizing SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori to enhance data visualization and insights generation
Promoting technological advances and fostering environments where people and technology thrive together
Identifying market gaps and converting opportunities into successful outcomes for the firm
Developing new ideas and solutions to drive thought leadership and innovation
Balancing long-term and short-term strategic thinking to address system-level enablers
Cultivating potential in others through mentorship and leadership across the PwC Network

What You Must Have

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 9 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

Preference for a Master's or Masters of Business Administration degree in at least one of the following fields of study: Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems, Engineering
Demonstrating proficiency in SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori
Utilizing Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) for business transformation
Leading strategic technology planning and systemic thinking initiatives
Excelling in strategic questioning and innovation for client solutions
Cultivating potential through coaching and feedback within teams
Promoting technological advances in SAP environments

added.title: Senior Building Technology Systems Director
added.description:
At Henderson, We're About More Than Just Buildings

We're about the people, experiences, and longevity of a building. We’re a company of problem-solvers and innovators known for our technical excellence and ability to provide come up with out-of-the-box solutions when it comes to design and construction. We love the process of bringing buildings to life – and keeping them in shape long after the doors open.

As an ESOP, each of our employee-owners are an essential part of our mission to lead the industry in innovation, sustainability, and client experience. With a vision to build a better world, Team Henderson has a people-first culture and diverse portfolio of world-class facilities.

It's What We Do

We provide total building system design and construction services across multiple high-growth markets throughout the country for industry leaders. You'll get to use your talent to work on projects for some of the biggest names in mission-critical, higher education, sports, healthcare, grocery, restaurant, and retail within the sectors we serve in business, community, grocery, health, retail, and venue.

It's How We're Different

We're about more than just buildings. We're about you. You, and the hundreds of passionate employee-owners who make us who we are. We’ve always been committed to providing an inclusive workplace where people can bring their full self to work and helps people reach their full potential – both as professionals and individuals. Together, we provide dream-up innovative solutions for our clients industry-wide problems, design and construct spaces that become landmarks, and toast the good life at our happy hours. Take a peek into what makes us different here: https://youtu.be/AIt17t_uJ-A?si=oSMy5zQeUcb_faE3

Posted Thursday, September 10th, 2026 | Expires Thursday, December 10th, 2026

Position Summary

The Sr Building Technology Systems Director acts as the national business leader for Building Technology Systems (BTS), a Strategic Growth Services business unit responsible for operational technology (OT) systems integration consulting, cybersecurity consulting specific to operational technology, telecommunications design consulting, electronic safety and security design consulting. Providing leadership in the development of building technology strategies that meet an owner's business and operational needs. The Sr Building Technology Systems Director sets the strategic direction for the company, manages investment decisions, and drives innovation across all service lines. Accountable for establishing, scaling, and leading the national Building Technology Systems practice, including business performance, talent strategy, technical excellence, and market growth.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, security management, or a related field required. Master's degree or higher in fields related to building technology, cybersecurity, or business administration is preferred.
Minimum of 15 years of relevant experience across telecommunications design, electronic safety and security design, operational technology, OT cybersecurity, or physical security consulting required, with at least 7 years in a leadership or management role with a proven track record of technical excellence, business unit growth, and strategic influence preferred.
Relevant experience in providing consultancy services to building owners and operators across Building Technology Systems is required.
Advanced knowledge of telecommunications infrastructure, electronic safety and security systems and operational technology principles required.
Proficiency in network design, OT/IT network architecture, and solutions architecture required.
Relevant certifications, such as PE, RCDD, CISSP, PSP, or CPP, reflecting depth of expertise across the BTS service lines required preferred.
Experience with integrated building management systems (IBMS), building automation systems (BAS), SCADA systems, access control and video surveillance platforms, and premise/outside plant telecommunications infrastructure required.

added.description:
The Opportunity

As a SAP Technology and D&A Director, you will lead the charge in optimizing operational efficiency for our clients by analyzing their needs, implementing software solutions, and providing comprehensive training and support. Within our Digital Core Modernisation network, you will specialize in utilizing and managing SAP software and solutions, focusing on installation, configuration, administration, development, and support of SAP products and technologies. As a Director, you will set the strategic direction and lead business development efforts, making impactful decisions and overseeing multiple projects while maintaining executive-level client relations. Translating the vision, you set the tone and inspire others to follow, driving business growth and shaping the direction of client engagements.

In this role at PwC, you will be a guardian of our reputation, understanding that quality, integrity, inclusion, and a commercial mindset are foundational to our success. You will create a healthy working environment while maximizing client satisfaction and cultivating the potential in others. By actively teaming across the PwC Network, you will leverage our collective strength to identify market gaps and convert opportunities into success for the firm.

Responsibilities

Leading strategic direction and business development efforts within SAP technology consulting
Overseeing installation, configuration, and administration of SAP products and technologies
Managing client engagements to optimize operational efficiency and achieve strategic objectives
Implementing software solutions and providing training for seamless integration of business applications
Utilizing SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori to enhance data visualization and insights generation
Promoting technological advances and fostering environments where people and technology thrive together
Identifying market gaps and converting opportunities into successful outcomes for the firm
Developing new ideas and solutions to drive thought leadership and innovation
Balancing long-term and short-term strategic thinking to address system-level enablers
Cultivating potential in others through mentorship and leadership across the PwC Network

What You Must Have

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 9 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

Preference for a Master's or Masters of Business Administration degree in at least one of the following fields of study: Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems, Engineering
Demonstrating proficiency in SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori
Utilizing Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) for business transformation
Leading strategic technology planning and systemic thinking initiatives
Excelling in strategic questioning and innovation for client solutions
Cultivating potential through coaching and feedback within teams
Promoting technological advances in SAP environments

About the Role

The organization is seeking an experienced technology operations leader with direct experience in data, data operations, hosting infrastructure, public and private cloud environments, development operations, and cybersecurity. This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the adoption and usage of advanced AI technologies across the operations organization to improve internal efficiency and accelerate product and business outcomes.
Track technology operational trends and AI advancements, identifying creative solutions to drive efficiency and greater throughput.
Provide leadership, vision, and strategy driving automation, stability, and availability of technology infrastructure leveraging cloud and on-premise technologies to support business agility.

Define the technology operations strategy and roadmap to support current and future business needs for scalability, capacity, and quality of service, including performance, reliability, and business continuity.

Partner with senior leadership across the business to realize measurable outcomes aligned with business expectations.

Define, maintain, and present regular operational metrics to executive leadership, including overall security, data, and infrastructure health, risk areas, and productivity.

Strong executive communication skills with the ability to convey technical details and strategy to non-technical leadership.

Experience with business processes, management, and budgeting.

added.title: VP of Technology & AI Infrastructure
added.description:
VP of Technology & AI Infrastructure

About the Opportunity

A national workforce development organization dedicated to connecting skilled, work-authorized professionals to career-aligned employment across the United States is seeking a VP of Technology & AI Infrastructure. The organization focuses on creating economic opportunity, scaling programmatic impact, and leveraging modern technology and artificial intelligence to drive operational efficiency and positive participant outcomes.

Role Overview

The VP of Technology & AI Infrastructure is responsible for defining and executing the organization’s technology strategy and infrastructure across internal operations and externally facing digital products. Reporting to the President and working closely with the CEO and executive leadership, this leader guides the organization toward an AI- and product-first model while upholding operational excellence, security, reliability, and scalable delivery practices. This role operates in a full-time, remote capacity within the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Own the overarching technology strategy across staff infrastructure and external user- and partner-facing products, ensuring systems are secure, scalable, cost-effective, and mission-aligned.
Build and maintain a multi-year technology roadmap encompassing staff infrastructure, IT operations, data systems and reporting, platform evolution, core digital products, and system integrations.
Translate organizational strategy into sequenced roadmaps with defined timelines, dependencies, resource requirements, and metrics.
Provide executive leadership with clear tradeoff analyses and recommendations on priorities based on organizational capacity and impact.
Support Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning and release planning.
Partner with product leadership to guide technical architecture, build-versus-buy evaluations, platform selection, integration strategy, and delivery for participant and partner platforms.
Establish technical standards and governance for responsible AI adoption in collaboration with cross-functional committees, covering data privacy, security controls, vendor risk management, quality assurance, bias mitigation, and human oversight.
Build the technical foundation for AI readiness, focusing on data quality, system integrations, and scalable infrastructure for feature deployment and experimentation.
Oversee internal IT operations and service delivery, including help desk support, hardware lifecycle management, access controls, onboarding, offboarding, and technical troubleshooting.
Define IT service standards, manage vendor relationships and managed service provider contracts, and lead staff training initiatives to maximize adoption of organizational infrastructure and AI tools.
Oversee the customer relationship management (CRM) platform and associated systems as the operational backbone for programs, development, and reporting.
Direct enterprise data strategy in collaboration with research and evaluation leadership to maintain reliable governance, dashboards, and reporting for program improvement, funding requirements, and executive decision-making.
Implement a consistent project management framework across technology initiatives to maintain accountability, predictability, and cross-functional transparency.
Lead cybersecurity strategy, data protection controls, and operational risk management, maintaining a risk register and presenting mitigations to executive leadership and the Board.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of technology leadership experience spanning IT operations, systems leadership, and product/engineering delivery.
Proven experience building or leading technology strategy across both internal infrastructure and externally facing digital products or platforms, including demonstrated experience with artificial intelligence.
Strong program and project delivery discipline with the ability to manage competing priorities in a resource-constrained environment.
Experience with AI implementation, data governance, and enterprise systems.
Demonstrated experience partnering with product leaders on strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, and technical execution.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical topics into actionable decisions for leadership.
Demonstrated commitment to the organization's workforce development mission.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Salesforce CRM platforms.

Compensation and Benefits

Base Salary Range: $200,000 – $225,000 annually. Actual salaries vary based on factors including location, experience, and performance.
Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; short-term disability and life insurance; paid parental leave; paid time off; a retirement plan with an employer match; and a remote work schedule.

Equal Opportunity Employer

The organization is committed to building an inclusive workplace where diversity is prioritized and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Discover more at www.medidata.com. Listen to our latest podcast, from Dreamers to Disruptors, and follow us at @Medidata.

About the Team:

FinOps operates like a product team: the business — Engineering, Product, Finance, Procurement, and Operations — is our customer, and cost/usage insight is the product. The FinOps Platform Engineering, Sr. Manager is the technical builder who makes that possible: this role owns the tooling, integrations, and automation that let FinOps operate as an autonomous, standalone unit rather than a group of people manually pulling numbers on request.

This is a hands-on engineering role at the Sr. Manager level. You will design, code, and ship the FinOps platform yourself — the title reflects seniority and scope of ownership, not a coordination or people-management function.

Responsibilities:

Design, build, and maintain the tooling and integrations that connect cost and usage data sources — AWS, Snowflake, and HDC (our clinical data cloud) — into a unified FinOps platform.
Build automated tagging enforcement and validation pipelines against the framework defined by the FinOps Architect, so compliance is built in at deploy time, not checked after the fact.
Build self-service tools and APIs that let Engineering, Product, and Finance pull their own cost and usage insights on demand — treating internal stakeholders as customers of a product, not requesters in a queue.
Own the data pipelines feeding executive and team-level dashboards (ThoughtSpot, Unified Portal), including reconciliation logic that ties attributed and unattributed spend back to the invoice — automating what would otherwise require manual analysis.
Automate cost allocation, showback/chargeback calculations, and unit-economics computations (e.g., cost per trial, cost per environment).
Instrument and meter AI/LLM usage and spend across providers — token-level telemetry, attribution to teams and workloads, and integration with gateway and measurement tooling — so AI cost is as visible and governable as cloud cost.
Build integrations with vendor and procurement systems to automate renewal tracking, contract data ingestion, and scorecard generation.
Build anomaly detection and automated alerting on cost and usage data, closing the gap between a monthly report and a real-time signal.
Build automation to audit and optimize Savings Plan / Reserved Instance coverage, rather than tracking it manually.
Partner with Engineering to instrument systems for cost and usage telemetry at the source, including detection of cost regressions introduced by code and configuration changes.
Own the technical roadmap for FinOps tooling, including build-vs-buy decisions on platform components.
Apply standard engineering rigor — version control, testing, CI/CD — to the FinOps tooling stack.
Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision making.

Qualifications:

7+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, or DevOps, with a Bachelor's degree; hands-on experience building FinOps or cloud cost management capabilities, products, or services is a strong plus.
Demonstrated fluency building with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or comparable) as an integral part of your production engineering workflow.
Hands-on engineering skills: proficiency in Python or a comparable language, strong SQL, and experience designing APIs and data pipelines.
Hands-on expertise with AWS and Snowflake, including integrating with cloud provider billing and usage data (e.g., AWS Cost & Usage Reports, Snowflake usage views) and BI/analytics platforms (e.g., ThoughtSpot, Tableau).
Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation (e.g., Terraform, CI/CD) sufficient to enforce tagging and policy at deploy time.
Ability to design and ship self-service tooling for internal stakeholders — a product mindset applied to an internal function.
Experience building alerting or anomaly-detection systems, or automating financial/operational calculations, is a plus.
Experience metering or governing AI/LLM usage and spend (token-level cost attribution, LLM gateways, or usage telemetry) is a plus.
Ability to work independently to stand up new integrations with minimal direction, in service of a standalone, self-sufficient FinOps function.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to partner closely with the FinOps Architect (technical framework design) and Program Manager (delivery cadence).
Exposure to regulated or compliance-driven environments is a plus.

added.description:
The Opportunity

As a SAP Technology and D&A Director, you will lead the charge in optimizing operational efficiency for our clients by analyzing their needs, implementing software solutions, and providing comprehensive training and support. Within our Digital Core Modernisation network, you will specialize in utilizing and managing SAP software and solutions, focusing on installation, configuration, administration, development, and support of SAP products and technologies. As a Director, you will set the strategic direction and lead business development efforts, making impactful decisions and overseeing multiple projects while maintaining executive-level client relations. Translating the vision, you set the tone and inspire others to follow, driving business growth and shaping the direction of client engagements.

In this role at PwC, you will be a guardian of our reputation, understanding that quality, integrity, inclusion, and a commercial mindset are foundational to our success. You will create a healthy working environment while maximizing client satisfaction and cultivating the potential in others. By actively teaming across the PwC Network, you will leverage our collective strength to identify market gaps and convert opportunities into success for the firm.

Responsibilities

Leading strategic direction and business development efforts within SAP technology consulting
Overseeing installation, configuration, and administration of SAP products and technologies
Managing client engagements to optimize operational efficiency and achieve strategic objectives
Implementing software solutions and providing training for seamless integration of business applications
Utilizing SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori to enhance data visualization and insights generation
Promoting technological advances and fostering environments where people and technology thrive together
Identifying market gaps and converting opportunities into successful outcomes for the firm
Developing new ideas and solutions to drive thought leadership and innovation
Balancing long-term and short-term strategic thinking to address system-level enablers
Cultivating potential in others through mentorship and leadership across the PwC Network

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 9 years of experience

Preference for a Master's or Masters of Business Administration degree in at least one of the following fields of study: Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems, Engineering
Demonstrating proficiency in SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Fiori
Utilizing Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) for business transformation
Leading strategic technology planning and systemic thinking initiatives

Cultivating potential through coaching and feedback within teams
Promoting technological advances in SAP environments

added.title: Senior Building Technology Systems Director
added.description:
At Henderson, We're About More Than Just Buildings

We're about the people, experiences, and longevity of a building. We’re a company of problem-solvers and innovators known for our technical excellence and ability to provide come up with out-of-the-box solutions when it comes to design and construction. We love the process of bringing buildings to life – and keeping them in shape long after the doors open.

As an ESOP, each of our employee-owners are an essential part of our mission to lead the industry in innovation, sustainability, and client experience. With a vision to build a better world, Team Henderson has a people-first culture and diverse portfolio of world-class facilities.

It's What We Do

We provide total building system design and construction services across multiple high-growth markets throughout the country for industry leaders. You'll get to use your talent to work on projects for some of the biggest names in mission-critical, higher education, sports, healthcare, grocery, restaurant, and retail within the sectors we serve in business, community, grocery, health, retail, and venue.

It's How We're Different

We're about more than just buildings. We're about you. You, and the hundreds of passionate employee-owners who make us who we are. We’ve always been committed to providing an inclusive workplace where people can bring their full self to work and helps people reach their full potential – both as professionals and individuals. Together, we provide dream-up innovative solutions for our clients industry-wide problems, design and construct spaces that become landmarks, and toast the good life at our happy hours. Take a peek into what makes us different here: https://youtu.be/AIt17t_uJ-A?si=oSMy5zQeUcb_faE3

Posted Thursday, September 10th, 2026 | Expires Thursday, December 10th, 2026

Position Summary

The Sr Building Technology Systems Director acts as the national business leader for Building Technology Systems (BTS), a Strategic Growth Services business unit responsible for operational technology (OT) systems integration consulting, cybersecurity consulting specific to operational technology, telecommunications design consulting, electronic safety and security design consulting. Providing leadership in the development of building technology strategies that meet an owner's business and operational needs. The Sr Building Technology Systems Director sets the strategic direction for the company, manages investment decisions, and drives innovation across all service lines. Accountable for establishing, scaling, and leading the national Building Technology Systems practice, including business performance, talent strategy, technical excellence, and market growth.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, security management, or a related field required. Master's degree or higher in fields related to building technology, cybersecurity, or business administration is preferred.
Minimum of 15 years of relevant experience across telecommunications design, electronic safety and security design, operational technology, OT cybersecurity, or physical security consulting required, with at least 7 years in a leadership or management role with a proven track record of technical excellence, business unit growth, and strategic influence preferred.
Relevant experience in providing consultancy services to building owners and operators across Building Technology Systems is required.
Advanced knowledge of telecommunications infrastructure, electronic safety and security systems and operational technology principles required.
Proficiency in network design, OT/IT network architecture, and solutions architecture required.
Relevant certifications, such as PE, RCDD, CISSP, PSP, or CPP, reflecting depth of expertise across the BTS service lines required preferred.
Experience with integrated building management systems (IBMS), building automation systems (BAS), SCADA systems, access control and video surveillance platforms, and premise/outside plant telecommunications infrastructure required.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity practices and risk assessment methodologies specific to operational technology environments preferred.
Familiarity with industry standards and regulations (e.g., NIST, IEC 62443, ISO 27001, BICSI, TIA/EIA, NFPA 730/731, UL 2050, NEC, IBC) required.
Proficiency with relevant software tools, including Bluebeam Revu, network/security design platforms, and Microsoft Office Suite required.

Essential Job Functions & Accountabilities

Strategic Leadership & Management:

Lead annual internal business planning and strategy sessions to set growth goals.
Develop and execute the financial strategy to meet financial and performance goals.
Provide strategic direction to the company around Building Technology Systems, shaping organizational goals, growth targets, execution plans, and investment strategies to advance the company's position in the industry.
Develop and enforce policies, procedures, and standards related to building technology systems, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and corporate guidelines.
Collaborate with sector and organizational leadership to align building technology systems approaches with company-wide strategies and initiatives

Building Technology Strategy & Innovation

Drive innovation in Building Technology Systems by staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies.
Evaluate and recommend new technologies and methodologies to enhance the company's service offerings and competitive edge.
Develop long-term strategy for the adoption and integration of advanced building technology systems within the company's projects and services.
Represent the company in industry forums and thought leadership activities to promote its expertise in Building Technology Systems.

Building Technology Solutions

Oversee the identification and quantification of problems experienced by building operators and owners.
Lead the team in gathering stakeholder needs and synthesizing them into clear, actionable visions.
Coordinate Building Technology Systems with building owners, owner representatives, General Contractor teams, and Commissioning agents.
Promote, educate, and consult on the integration of intelligent building systems to enhance overall building performance and client value.
Lead the development and implementation of consulting strategies specific to operational technology environments.
Evaluate, validate, and select appropriate vendor platforms and tools that meet solution needs.

Client Relations & Business Development

Leverage opportunities and relationships internally across Henderson Companies and externally across the industry to develop business growth.
Lead the development, establishment, and maintenance of relationships with strategic partners and customers in support of and to expand business opportunities.
Lead and provide input on client engagement strategies, project pursuits, and project execution.
Represent Henderson Companies at client, company, and/or industry events to build and maintain professional relationships.
Drive collaboration with HEI sectors and HBS teams to develop, define, and execute company-wide strategies.
Earn the trust of senior leaders at client organizations and partner with them to create strategic solutions at the intersection of business, technology infrastructure, cybersecurity, physical safety & security, and facility operations.
Build relationships with clients to raise Henderson Companies' profile as long-term trusted advisor and partner.
Develop and strengthen the Building Technology Systems business and role as a thought leader by creating content and taking part in professional forums, both internal and external.
Resolve conflicts involving clients, architects, contractors, and facility managers related to building technology systems matters.
Align technical execution to streamline client experience and maximize client satisfaction.

Team Leadership & Technical Excellence

Establish goal planning for team members and conduct recurring check-ins.
Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement within the team and organization.
Demonstrate an organization-wide mindset, cooperating across sector and operations teams to collectively meet organizational goals.
Mentor and develop staff to build a strong succession pipeline across the Building Technology Systems disciplines.
Ensure technical execution aligns with organization-wide technical expertise and capabilities.
Empower team members to deal with ambiguity and maintain consistent standards of service and results.
Engage resources in response to areas in need of improvement, fostering a culture of quality.

updated.title: Data Center Chief Engineer Night Role
updated.description:
Description

Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.

The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response. The CE serves as an expert technical resource interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support AWS.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Relocation assistance will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities

Act as the primary escalation point for all facilities-related issues. Oversee operation and management of routine and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.
Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures and troubleshooting of facility within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).
Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians and are responsible for working with Facility Manager (FM) to set team culture.
Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams
May assist in the building out of new facilities and assist in projects to increase current facility efficiency
Working outside of normal business hours for routine maintenance as required, including responding to out-of-hours emergency calls.
Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience.
Work with IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability and efficiency
Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff
Establish building performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility of operations and maintenance.
Utilize Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook and other basic administrative tools to perform day-to-day tasks

Physical Requirements

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodation:
Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

Essential Requirements

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 3+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 2+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
3+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in data center engineering or operations
Experience in construction or project management
Experience leading technical teams through daily operations and maintenance evolutions
Can work in an environment that involves walking, stooping, bending, and climbing to access equipment
